description: Migrate all dashboards from source to target.

action.description: Conflict strategy applied to every dashboard.

examples.user_query: Migrate all dashboards, skipping any that already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates all dashboards from the source environment to the target environment, skipping any dashboards that already exist in the target.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate all dashboards and overwrite any existing ones?
examples.notes: This call migrates all dashboards from the source environment to the target environment, overwriting any dashboards that already exist in the target.

examples.user_query: I want to migrate all dashboards but create duplicates for any conflicts. Can I do that?
examples.notes: This call migrates all dashboards from the source environment to the target environment, creating duplicates for any conflicting dashboards. The concurrency level is set to 5 for faster processing.

description: Migrate specific dashboards from source to target.

dashboard_ids.description: Dashboard OIDs to migrate. Provide either this or ``dashboard_names``.

dashboard_names.description: Dashboard titles to migrate. Provide either this or ``dashboard_ids``.

action.description: Conflict strategy when a dashboard with the same ``oid`` already exists on the target. - ``"skip"`` — leave the existing dashboard unchanged. - ``"overwrite"`` — replace the existing dashboard with the source version. - ``"duplicate"`` — always create, regardless of conflicts.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of dashboards to migrate concurrently, run via a background thread pool (``asyncio.to_thread``) since the underlying HTTP client is synchronous. Dashboards are independent of each other, so any value is safe. Values <= 1 (the default) process dashboards one at a time.

examples.user_query: Migrate all dashboards, skipping any that already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates all dashboards from the source to the target environment, skipping any dashboards that already exist on the target.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate dashboards 'Sales Overview' and 'Marketing Insights', overwriting any existing ones?
examples.notes: This call migrates the specified dashboards by name, overwriting any dashboards with the same OID that already exist on the target.

examples.user_query: Migrate dashboards with IDs 'dash123' and 'dash456', creating duplicates if they already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates the specified dashboards by ID, always creating duplicates on the target regardless of conflicts.
